name: ai-search
description: AI-powered semantic search using Cloudflare Workers AI and Vectorize for embedding-based retrieval.

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: Your Cloudflare account ID for Workers AI

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN
envVars.description: API token for Cloudflare Workers AI

envVars.name: VECTORIZE_INDEX_NAME
envVars.description: Name of the Vectorize index for semantic search

ai.whenToUse: When the user wants semantic or AI-powered search across documentation, blog posts, or other content using Cloudflare Vectorize.
ai.whenNotToUse: For simple text filtering or when the project has no searchable content. Not needed for static sites with client-side search.
